review_scope: Contact sheets generated from native crops; individual PNG endpoints inspected at native crop dimensions for first-ball visibility and ramp-exit proxies. Mechanism pairs additionally checked in PTS-labelled contact sheets. Metadata and manifest references are verified separately.
timing_interpretation: Point event times remain NA for every event. Bounds identify a change in reviewed source images; they are not empirical confidence intervals on world time.

Adjacent encoded PTS intervals around33.367ms do not establish33.367ms physical accuracy. Blur/exposure, held/near-held crops, encoding, motion threshold, perspective and gate occlusion remain systematic unknowns.
Identical cropped images at consecutive PTS prove repeated crop content only; they do not prove a dropped or duplicate full camera frame.
The ramp proxy uses the front housing/post silhouette as a visible reference; it is not a calibrated permanent-selection plane. No permanent isolation or absolute paddle angle/RPM is inferred.
The reviewed source pixels and rendered metadata do not provide independent human validation; two AI reviews can share errors.
